content:
Morgan: quick heads-up — vendor pushed APAC baremetal racks from Fri -> Mon. they say firmware flash needed before handoff. this affects the demo pool.
Jamal: timeline on firmware? can our oncall flash remotely or does vendor need sysadmin onsite?
Morgan: vendor says onsite is preferred but will accept remote if we provide a signed access window + kube creds. ETA for rack readiness now 2026-03-29 09:00 local (per vendor).
Ellie: how many GPUs are we losing from the APAC burst slice? we have an evening loadtest scheduled.
Morgan: 12 A100s in that slice. demo wanted to use 8 concurrently; quota currently 12 in apac-proj.
Riya: can we borrow 8 from EU-standby for the test window? would need network route and permission grant.
Vlad: EU can spare 6 during that window, not 8. also EU has RDMA tuning in progress -> latency risk.
Jamal: if EU only gives 6, we need to either reduce batch size or move canary to us-east. cost vs latency tradeoff.
Ellie: option: move canary to us-east and keep training in APAC later. but we need a quick quota bump in us-east to 16 GPUs for the slot.
Morgan: filed a reservation request with finance/allocs. ops-bot responded below.
ops-bot: Reservation request submitted: #RES-4521 — region=us-east, gpus=+4, priority=high. Approvers: @finance, @allocs. ETA: ~3h for approval.
Riya: if approvers stall, fallback plan: reduce batch_size from 8 -> 5 and enable kv-cache warmup to keep latency within SLO.
Jamal: can someone paste the terraform snippet to adjust pool size quickly? I can PR after approval.
Vlad: use this quick patch for the tenant pool:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "demo" {
  region = "us-east1"
  gpu_count = var.gpu_count
  preemptible = false
}
```
Jamal: thx — I'll prepare a PR with var override to 16 and link the vault creds for canary nodes.
Ellie: QA note: if we migrate canary, update the endpoint DNS TTL to 60s before cutover.
Morgan: agreed. I'll ping @allocs and @finance in a sec. if approval comes through, Jamal you can merge and Vlad you can coordinate the flash slot with vendor.
Jamal: got it. will stand by.
Vlad: will call vendor ops at 10:30 PT to confirm they can accept remote flash once reservation is confirmed. will update here.
Morgan: thanks all. if anything blocks, drop a :rotating_light: and tag me.
Ellie: quick follow — should we add a post-mortem checklist item about vendor firmware visibility? recurring issue.
Morgan: yes, add to infra backlog: "vendor-firmware-visibility". Riya, can you open the ticket after this thread? :+1:
Riya: on it, filing now.
